milestones.goal: J1 and J2 end to end on the demo collection with sample-mode recovery, deployed on a public URL
the desk finished to the UI spec, live Qloo when the key arrives, docs, gates, final take and submission

tasks.title: Demo collection and presets
tasks.objective: Fetch the most-borrowed 2025 BOOK titles with ISBNs from Seattle Public Library's open data into data/collection.json, write data/presets.json (ten documented invented titles, two real ones), and a catalog module that finds a title by normalised title+author or ISBN
acceptance: WHEN the catalog is asked for 'Beautiful Ruins' by 'Jess Walter' THE SYSTEM SHALL return the held item with its ISBN and copies
WHEN asked for 'The Last Algorithm' by 'Andy Weir' THE SYSTEM SHALL return nothing
data/collection.json holds at least 2,000 distinct ISBN-13s, each with title, author and subjects

tasks.title: Three-source check with verdict (SSE)
tasks.objective: GET /api/check streams one event per source (collection, Open Library, Google Books by title and author) with result and elapsed ms, 6 s timeout each, then a verdict event: no_record | held | not_held | with failed sources named
acceptance: AC-2
AC-3
AC-4
WHEN a source throws or exceeds 6 s THE SYSTEM SHALL emit {result:'failed'} for it and continue
tasks.notes: RED first on the verdict rules with injected source results

tasks.title: Qloo client, sample mode and recovery route
tasks.objective: QlooClient interface; LiveQloo (search, insights for books with chunked filter.results.entities, exclusions, explainability parse, redacted request capture); SampleQloo (deterministic subject-overlap pick from the collection, labelled); POST /api/recover returns three distinct held titles with reasons and the mode; per-IP rate limit 20/min; no key reaches the client
acceptance: AC-5
AC-6
AC-10
AC-13
WHEN the live client gets a 401 THE SYSTEM SHALL fall back to sample mode and label it 'Qloo key pending'
tasks.notes: the live client is unit-tested against recorded-shape fixtures written by hand from the docs, not Qloo responses; the first real call happens when the key arrives (A-1)

tasks.title: Desk golden path (ugly is fine)
tasks.objective: The desk page runs J1 end to end against the real routes: presets, title and author fields, Check, three drawers answering from the SSE stream, the patron card by verdict, the seeds row, the shelf with covers and reasons, the mode label; no styling beyond tokens
acceptance: WHEN the page opens THE SYSTEM SHALL show preset 1 already checked
WHEN Check is pressed THE SYSTEM SHALL open the drawers one by one as events arrive and then show the card and the shelf
AC-6 on screen
tasks.notes: UI-SPEC §5 S1 layout; styling comes in T06

tasks.title: Persistence: runs, holds, registry, cache, map
tasks.objective: Drizzle schema and lazy Neon client with an in-memory adapter for tests; POST /api/holds (idempotent per run id), POST /api/log (insert or increment), GET /api/registry, GET /api/request/last; the registry seeded with the ten documented invented titles marked example; the /invented page as rows
acceptance: AC-7
AC-8
AC-9 (server side: the stored request carries no key)
tasks.rollback: git revert; drop tables with drizzle-kit (no production data)
tasks.notes: Neon provisioning needs the account owner to accept the Marketplace terms (vercel integration add neon); until DATABASE_URL exists the routes use the in-memory adapter locally and the deploy stays in that mode with a visible label

tasks.title: Desk to the UI spec: hierarchy, states, responsive, motion
tasks.objective: Build S1 to UI-SPEC §5 and the mockup: tokens and fonts, the treatment table, every state via ?state=, 320/390/1024/1440, choreography T-01 to T-07, the judge card (?judge=1), ?record=1, reset and replay shortcuts, the request panel (P1), reserve and log wired to T05
acceptance: AC-1
AC-11
WHEN ?state=no-seed THE SYSTEM SHALL show the empty shelf with the one line
WHEN the viewport is 390 wide THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the primary action visible (sticky) and never scroll sideways
tasks.notes: verify-states starts the built app, screenshots every ?state= at 390 and 1440 into qa/, and fails on a horizontal scrollbar or a missing primary action

tasks.title: Deploy to Vercel and smoke the live URL
tasks.objective: Production deploy on the project's URL with env vars set (DATABASE_URL when Neon exists, QLOO_API_KEY when it arrives, NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO=1), migrations pushed, seed run, pb.py smoke on /, /invented, /about, /api/registry; the browser pass signed out
acceptance: WHEN the live URL opens signed out THE SYSTEM SHALL show the desk with preset 1 checked within 2.5 s
WHEN /api/check is called on the live URL THE SYSTEM SHALL stream three events
verify: observe: live URL opens signed out with the finished run and no console errors
observe: pb.py smoke passes on the four routes
tasks.rollback: vercel rollback to the previous deployment

tasks.title: Backup take of the demo on the live URL
tasks.objective: Record the demo script once on the deployed build as the backup take; fix nothing new
acceptance: WHEN the recording is played THE SYSTEM SHALL show the full demo script from the contract §11
verify: observe: a recording of the deployed run exists and is linked in state.md
tasks.notes: product-demo-video gets the URL and the script

tasks.title: Landing layer, README, LICENSE, run log, print slip
tasks.objective: /about with the copy block, live-vs-simulated table, sources and links; README first screen (one sentence, screenshot, live link) with the sections How Qloo is used, What makes it Qloo-powered, Configuration; LICENSE MIT; the visible run log on the desk; the print stylesheet for the patron slip
acceptance: AC-12
WHEN /about opens THE SYSTEM SHALL show the headline, subhead, three proof points, three steps, the limits and the links

tasks.title: Reading lists (second mode)
tasks.objective: /lists: the readers'-advisory form prefilled with a labelled fictional sample, the same shelf component with five to ten held titles and reasons, Approve, a draft email shown and copyable, labelled not sent
acceptance: AC-14
tasks.notes: SHOULD; skip if the clock is short

tasks.title: Live Qloo switch-on and the first real run
tasks.objective: When QLOO_API_KEY arrives: one real Search and Insights call recorded (latency, explainability present or not), the map built for the collection (ISBN lookups), the live mode verified on the deployed URL, the replay recorded
acceptance: WHEN a real run completes THE SYSTEM SHALL show mode 'Qloo' on the shelf with per-seed shares, and the panel SHALL show the real request
A-2 and A-3 validated and recorded
verify: observe: one live run on the deployed URL in Qloo mode with the request panel showing explainability (or the degraded reason line, recorded)
tasks.rollback: unset the key; sample mode returns
tasks.notes: blocked on the key (A-1); if it never arrives, skip with the reason and the README says sample mode

tasks.title: Gates: security checklist, fresh review, design/UX review
tasks.objective: Secrets scan and bundle grep for the key; validation and limits on the write routes; a fresh-context reviewer with the checklist and a bug hunt; prod-ui A8 gates 1 to 4 including foldcheck on the live URL and the skeptical evaluator on three stills; fix what is safe
acceptance: WHEN the client bundle is grepped for the Qloo key prefix THE SYSTEM SHALL return nothing
WHEN foldcheck runs on the live URL THE SYSTEM SHALL pass at 1440x900 and 390x844
verify: observe: security checklist completed and reviewer report saved
observe: foldcheck pass recorded on the live URL
tasks.notes: the merged gate task for hackathon mode

tasks.title: QA: demo flow three times, states, axe, failure injection
tasks.objective: Run the exact demo script three times in a row on the deployed URL with a reset between; screenshot every ?state= at 390 and 1440; axe clean on the four routes; kill the network mid-run and confirm the drawers report 'did not answer' and the card renders
acceptance: WHEN the demo script runs three times THE SYSTEM SHALL complete each time without a dead state
verify: observe: three consecutive demo runs recorded with reset

tasks.title: Final take in the freeze
tasks.objective: Record the final demo on the frozen deployed build
acceptance: WHEN the final take is played THE SYSTEM SHALL match the contract's demo script
verify: observe: the final recording exists and is linked
tasks.notes: optional for this event (no video required); still made for the Devpost page

tasks.title: Submit
tasks.objective: README first screen final, the Devpost description (the copy block), rules ledger confirmed, pb.py window and submit check passing, every link opened signed out
acceptance: WHEN pb.py submit check runs THE SYSTEM SHALL report no FAIL
